description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5950007732782 COIL,ELECTRICAL: Line 0001 Qty 116 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0081 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
